tasks.title: Review model and freeze interface contract
tasks.acceptance: Confirm units, assumptions, sensor observability and baseline scenario expectations; record open questions. Do not add physics yet.

tasks.title: Numerical refinement report
tasks.acceptance: Separate solver-tolerance and controller-tick refinement; predeclare per-state and event-time metrics; preserve failing traces.

tasks.title: Generic adapter and strict scenarios
tasks.acceptance: Add explicit Protocols, schema versions, unknown-field rejection, finite/range checks, configurable sensor limits, integer-tick scheduling and a second simple plant.

tasks.title: Independent evaluators and traceable reports
tasks.acceptance: Separate scoring from runner, add tracking/detection/containment metrics, unassessable status and requirement-to-evidence matrix.

tasks.title: Fault combinations and uncertainty screening
tasks.acceptance: Add delays, lost commands and targeted combined faults; no controller truth leakage; document hypothetical parameter ranges and missed-detection cases.

tasks.title: Calibration/holdout experiment
tasks.acceptance: Optional: collect actual low-energy rig data, calibrate on whole runs, reserve different runs, assess residuals and measurement uncertainty. Remain pending if data unavailable.

tasks.title: Pressure operating-point or thermal extension
tasks.acceptance: Select one extension based on test question; derive conservation laws, document property/curve pedigree and add analytic benchmarks before control.

tasks.title: Portfolio demonstration
tasks.acceptance: Fresh-checkout reproduction, five-minute demo and accurate credibility statement; include one known limitation and uncontained fault.
